item.title: Xteink X4 Pro Wallet Case
item.description:
I’ve been reading on Xteink devices in the past year (and succesfully destroyed 2 of them, an X4 and an X3… next up to order was the X4 Pro (with backlight!). You might wonder why I keep on order stuff after I break them.. but I’m kind of addicted to the pocket format and being able to read quickly instead of using my mobile phone.

My reading habits have increased over the past year since getting a device like this. However the X4 Pro is too large to fit next to my phone (with magsafe). I also was due for a new wallet and thus figured it was time to tinker around!
